Overview
Learn how the key features of this comprehensive solution empower field service teams and operators, optimize operations, reduce environmental impact, and enhance both customer and operator satisfaction.
Real-time scheduling
Gain a holistic view of available resources and the work backlog to optimize schedules, boost resource utilization, and improve service quality.
Plan both urgent repairs and multi-day projects in one view to streamline dispatching and project delivery.
Assign technicians or full crews by skill, role, and shift to ensure the right people are on every job.
Easily rebalance workloads via drag-and-drop functionality to minimize idle time and prevent over-scheduling.
Simulate schedule adjustments to optimize routes, maximize technician working time, and handle emergency calls.
Track live technician status and travel progress to react quickly and maintain service-level agreements (SLAs).
Respond instantly to absences or delays with smart rescheduling to keep commitments on track.
Gain a holistic view of available resources and the work backlog to optimize schedules, boost resource utilization, and improve service quality.

AI insights and recommendations
The Joule copilot is embedded in the planning board to help guide dispatchers with proactive recommendations to improve technician utilization and service quality.
Use AI to match jobs with the best technician based on skills and location, reducing travel time and cost.
Get predictive insights on job duration and travel time based on historical data to improve accuracy and planning confidence.
Access AI-driven order or equipment insights highlighting probable root causes or suggesting parts to bring when dispatching.
Simplify job searching with intelligent filters that interpret natural language commands to deliver precise results in seconds.
Review the auto-scheduling report to have full visibility into AI-generated schedules and routes, ensuring balanced workloads and efficient resource use.
Design custom policies for assisted or automated scheduling using a no-code designer.
